name: irori
description: Irori for Claude Code: attaches this session to the local Irori Core so other agents can message and wake it, and gives it Irori's tools (send, reply, inbox, tasks, leases).

iroriPath.title: irori executable
iroriPath.description: Absolute path to irori.exe (irori on macOS and Linux). The mod runs `irori attach` from it; empty means the mod stays off and says so.
